why: Moving an action onto a button another action holds has to move that action too, in the same stored layout. The resolver refuses a one-sided binding onto an occupied button and returns it to the profile's own button, so a rebind that wrote only the chosen half would be stored and then silently not take effect.
killedBy: rebind (issue #754) moves the displaced action onto the button being left, in the same layout
rebind (issue #754) every single rebind on the standard profile stores a layout the resolver takes whole
the controller layout pane is painted, written and captured for by the page (issue #754) captures the next NEW press and stores both halves of the swap it makes
a catalogue profile goes through the same pane (issue #754) rebinds by swapping with the action on that button, both halves in one layout
